# Wildbox

> Wildbox is an open-source (MIT), self-hosted security operations platform run with Docker Compose: an OpenResty gateway in front of Python microservices for identity, security tools, threat intelligence data, vulnerability management, cloud security posture management (CSPM), incident response playbooks and optional AI-assisted analysis, plus a Next.js dashboard. It is in an early evaluation phase.

What exists today, as defined by `docker-compose.yml` in the repository. Ports, routes and counts below were taken from the code; when in doubt, the repository is authoritative. Release notes are in CHANGELOG.md.

## Services

- **Gateway (`open-security-gateway`)**: OpenResty. The only service published beyond localhost: HTTPS on 443; ports 80 and 8080 answer `/health` and redirect everything else to HTTPS. Validates JWTs and API keys with the identity service, rate-limits per team, routes `/api/v1/<service>/` to each backend.
- **Identity (`open-security-identity`)**: FastAPI with fastapi-users. Users, JWT login (`POST /auth/jwt/login` through the gateway, form-encoded `username`/`password`), token revocation, API keys, teams with owner/admin/member roles, account lockout.
- **Tools (`open-security-tools`)**: Runs 52 security tools (scanners, analyzers, OSINT and crypto utilities) through an API, with Celery workers.
- **Data (`open-security-data`)**: Collects threat intelligence (IOCs, denylists) from public sources on a schedule and serves lookups.
- **Guardian (`open-security-guardian`)**: Django REST. Assets, vulnerabilities, remediation, compliance and reporting.
- **Responder (`open-security-responder`)**: Executes YAML incident-response playbooks through connectors.
- **CSPM (`open-security-cspm`)**: 31 cloud configuration checks across AWS, Azure and GCP.
- **Agents (`open-security-agents`)**: Optional AI-assisted IOC analysis using the Anthropic API (Claude) when `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is set; submitted data is then sent to Anthropic.
- **Sensor (`open-security-sensor`)**: Endpoint telemetry via osquery, forwarded to the data service; not routed through the gateway.
- **Dashboard (`open-security-dashboard`)**: Next.js web UI, served through the gateway.
- Optional Compose profiles: `automations` (n8n), `monitoring` (Prometheus), `backup` (scheduled PostgreSQL backups).

Wildbox does not include a SIEM, a WAF or a local LLM runtime.

## Docs

- [Quick Start](https://www.wildbox.io/guides/quickstart/): generate secrets, start the stack, log in, call the API
- [Service ports](https://www.wildbox.io/guides/ports/): every service, container and port
- [Gateway routes](https://www.wildbox.io/docs.html#gateway-routes): public paths and the service behind each
- [Credentials and authentication](https://www.wildbox.io/guides/credentials/): how secrets are generated; no default credentials exist
- [Deployment guide](https://www.wildbox.io/guides/deployment/): production setup, TLS, backups
- [API documentation](https://www.wildbox.io/docs.html#api-docs): per-service endpoint references
- [Security status](https://www.wildbox.io/security/status/): known open issues and how each check was made

## Optional

- [Full context](https://www.wildbox.io/llms-full.txt): the same facts in more detail
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/fabriziosalmi/wildbox): source, issues, CHANGELOG.md
